title: A delightful experience!
text: I would highly recommend this cooking of a traditional Catalonia meal with Hana to anyone interested in a delightful and entertaining afternoon!  Hana is a very knowledgeable instructor and explains each step in preparing this delicious meal.  My husband and I enjoyed our time with her in the market before our cooking session in her home kitchen.  She told us the history behind the dishes we prepared and then ate.  I hope others will give this experience a try and enjoy Hana’s company as much as we did.
author: Roger_G

title: Very personal.
text: Hana was a doll. She welcomed us into her home for a wonderful cooking experience. What turned it extra special is that we were so, she sat down with us for a long conversation that we thoroughly enjoyed. We highly recommend her services.
author: Neil_P
